cardEffects:
You may digivolve this card from your hand onto one of your blue Tamers as if the Tamer is a level 3 blue Digimon for a memory cost of 2.
[When Digivolving] If a card with the [Hybrid] trait or [Tommy Himi] is in this Digimon's digivolution cards, 1 of your opponent's Digimon with no digivolution cards can't attack or block until the end of their next turn.
name: Korikakumon

rulings.answer: No, Tamer cards' [Security] effects aren't inherited effects. Some Tamer cards do have inherited effects, and those can be activated when such cards are placed in digivolution cards.
rulings.question: When this Digimon digivolves onto a Tamer card, does the Tamer card’s [Security] effect become an inherited effect?
Instead of a Tamer card, can I digivolve this card onto a level 3 Digimon that meets the digivolution requirements?

rulings.answer: Yes, it is.  However, if the effect specifies Digimon cards, Digi-Egg cards, or any other type of card that isn't a Tamer card, it can't be targeted by that effect.
rulings.question: After a Tamer card ends up in this Digimon's digivolution cards, is that card affected by effects that trash digivolution cards?

rulings.answer: Yes, you do. Even if you digivolve using a Tamer card, make sure to draw 1 card as the digivolution bonus.
rulings.question: If I digivolve this card on top of a Tamer card, do I still get the digivolution bonus?

rulings.answer: Yes. Digivolution doesn't count as “playing” a card, so you can attack that turn.
rulings.question: Can I attack the turn I digivolve this card on top of a Tamer card?

rulings.answer: No. Since it's the first turn the Tamer was played, the limitation for attacking on the first turn a card is played still applies.
rulings.question: I play a Tamer card, then digivolve it into this Digimon. Can I then attack with that Digimon during that same turn?
If I've digivolved this card on top of a Tamer card and the Digimon is deleted, what happens to the Tamer card?

rulings.answer: No. Once a Digimon is targeted by this card's [When Digivolving] effect, it becomes unable to attack or block until the end of your opponent’s turn, even if it gains a digivolution card.
rulings.question: When this card's [When Digivolving] effect prevents a Digimon from attacking or blocking, if that Digimon gains a digivolution card afterwards, can it attack or block?
